newsitem.title: USA: AAR to provide services to UNC unit.
newsitem.headline: AAR to provide services to UNC unit.

text.p: AAR Corp said Monday it signed a 10-year agreement to provide inventory management and support services to UNC Industrial Power, a subsidiary of UNC Inc.
The agreement, worth a minimum of $40 million, involves UNC's overhaul and refurbishment programs on Solar Saturn and Solar Centaur industrial gas turbine engines, AAR said.
AAR also bought part of UNC Industrial Power's existing parts inventory and secured the rights to sell the parts to third parties as well as to UNC Industrial Power.
AAR provides aerospace and aviation products and services.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Monday at 25-5/8.
